Domestic supply therefore not verified — null, not inferred.
note: Exports are factually confirmed by customs B/L records, not by website claims: three dated outbound shipments in Oct 2024 (Genoa IT, Hamburg DE, Misurata LY) under HS 84822012, plus a 2025-05-14 re-import row from Ferdinand Bilstein GmbH. Declared HS 848220 matches the observed 8-digit codes 84822011/84822012 (tapered roller bearings) — no HS correction needed. Caveat on evidence depth: only 5 of the 2099 records the source claims were visible in the free view, so the visible sample is a small fraction; the confirmed status rests on those specific dated rows, not on the aggregate counter. Domestic (India) supply side is unverified — no GST turnover band, tender or contract record obtained, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found. Note the ImportKey page also lists this entity as an importer (suppliers Ningbo Amol Intl. Trade, Wuxing Global, Fersa Bearings, Ferdinand Bilstein), consistent with a manufacturer that both imports components and exports finished bearings. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the sources read, so those fields are null.
